tests: Three camps of similar size, each centered on a different expensive proposal.

proposals.title: Robotics build week
proposals.description: Parts and a mentor for teams building small robots over one week.

proposals.title: Yoga and breathwork retreat day
proposals.description: A full day at a retreat center with two instructors and meals.

proposals.title: Spice plantation visit
proposals.description: Bus, entry, and a guided tour of a spice plantation with lunch.

proposals.title: Printed event map and guide
proposals.description: A printed map of venues, routes, and local services.

proposals.title: Beach bonfire nights
proposals.description: Firewood, permits, and a fire safety person for weekly bonfires.

proposals.title: Hackerspace soldering stations
proposals.description: Three soldering stations with fume extractors at The Circle.

proposals.title: Wine tasting evening
proposals.description: A sommelier-led tasting of Indian wines.

opinions: The robotics build week is why I came. Soldering stations would help too. A printed map would help newcomers find things.
Robotics week, definitely, and the soldering stations. The map is a good small thing. No wine tasting, not everyone drinks.
Fund the retreat day; most of us are burned out. Bonfires are lovely. The map makes sense. Skip the wine tasting.
The retreat day and the bonfires. A printed map, yes. Wine tasting excludes people who don't drink.
I want the spice plantation visit, it's real Goa. Bonfires too. The map is useful. No wine.
Spice plantation trip please. And a printed map for sure. Wine tasting is not inclusive.
disagreements: Persons 1-2 want the robotics week and soldering stations, Persons 3-4 want the retreat day and bonfires, Persons 5-6 want the plantation visit (Person 5 also bonfires). The fund fits at most two of the three big proposals.

previous_slate.summary: Fund robotics and the retreat day, plus the map.

critiques: Good, but robotics at $1,800 is tight. Fine overall.
Okay. I'd add soldering stations by trimming the retreat.
Happy with this.
Good, though I'd like bonfires too.
The plantation visit got nothing. Swap it in for robotics or the retreat.
Leaving out the plantation entirely isn't fair. Fund it at its minimum and cut the other two.
disagreements: Persons 5-6 want the plantation visit swapped in; Persons 1, 3 are content; Persons 2 and 4 want small additions (soldering stations, bonfires).

tests: A larger pool where the critique round reveals a new shared objection.

proposals.title: Drone light show
proposals.description: A 50-drone light show over the beach on the final night.

proposals.title: Founder mentorship dinners
proposals.description: Weekly dinners pairing experienced founders with new builders.

proposals.title: Beach accessibility mats
proposals.description: Mats and a ramp so wheelchair users can reach the water.

proposals.title: Open science grants
proposals.description: Small grants for attendees running experiments during the event.

proposals.title: Local music nights
proposals.description: Pay local bands to play twice a week.

proposals.title: Shuttle between venues
proposals.description: A shuttle van running between the three main venues.

opinions: A drone show would be a magical ending. Accessibility mats are important. Science grants are great.
Accessibility mats are a must. I'd fund the science grants generously. The drone show feels wasteful.
Mats, shuttle, and music nights. Practical things.
The drone show! And the mats, everyone should be able to swim.
Accessibility mats first. Founder dinners would help me a lot.
Science grants and mats. The shuttle would save so much time.
Mats for sure. Local music nights support the community here.
disagreements: The drone show (Persons 1, 4 for; Person 2 against) versus spreading money across grants, shuttle, music, and dinners.
How much to put into science grants (Persons 1, 2, 6) versus practical items like the shuttle (Persons 3, 6) and music (Persons 3, 7).

previous_slate.summary: Fund the drone show, the mats, science grants, and the shuttle.

allocations.reason: A memorable ending two people want.

critiques: I just learned the drone show needs a permit that won't arrive in time. Drop it.
Agree, drop the drone show, the permit won't come through. Put it into grants.
The drone show can't get a permit, so it should get nothing. Add music nights.
Sad, but the permit issue is real. No drone show. Maybe music nights instead.
Drop the drone show given the permit problem. Add founder dinners.
Without a permit the drone show is impossible. More for the shuttle and grants.
No drone show then. Music nights please.
disagreements: Where the $2,500 from the drone show goes: grants (Persons 2, 6), music nights (Persons 3, 4, 7), founder dinners (Person 5), shuttle (Person 6).

tests: A requested reserve plus two shared vetoes, leaving a narrow set of options.

proposals.title: Prediction market game
proposals.description: A play-money prediction market on event outcomes, with prizes.

proposals.title: Jet ski rentals
proposals.description: Subsidized jet ski rentals for attendees.

proposals.title: Mangrove kayaking tour
proposals.description: Guided kayaking through the mangroves with a naturalist.

proposals.title: Women in tech breakfast
proposals.description: Weekly breakfasts for women and nonbinary builders.

proposals.title: Late-night ramen bar
proposals.description: A ramen stand open until 2am at The Circle.

proposals.title: Philosophy walks
proposals.description: Guided walks with discussion prompts at dawn.

opinions: Keep $500 back for things that come up later. Jet skis are noisy and bad for the reef, no. The ramen bar would keep people up too late, no. I like the kayaking tour.
Hold $500 in reserve. No jet skis, they disturb the wildlife. No ramen bar. The prediction market sounds fun.
Reserve $500. Skip jet skis and the late-night ramen. The women in tech breakfast matters to me.
Agree on keeping $500 back. Jet skis and the ramen bar are both bad ideas. Kayaking and philosophy walks.
Keep $500 in reserve. No jet skis, no ramen bar. Prediction market and the breakfasts.
disagreements: How to split $2,500 among kayaking (Persons 1, 4), the prediction market (Persons 2, 5), the breakfasts (Persons 3, 5), and philosophy walks (Person 4).

previous_slate.summary: Fund kayaking, the prediction market, and the breakfasts, keeping $500 back.

critiques: Good.
Fine, the market is in.
Good, the breakfasts are fully funded.
Philosophy walks are only $250 and got nothing. I'd cut kayaking a bit to fit them.
Looks right.
disagreements: Whether to trim kayaking to fit philosophy walks (Person 4) or keep the draft (Persons 1, 2, 3, 5).

tests: Nine people with a broad majority view and two strong minority views.

proposals.title: Coworking upgrades
proposals.description: Better chairs, fans, and power strips at The Circle.

proposals.title: Ayurveda clinic day
proposals.description: A local Ayurveda doctor offers consultations for a day.

proposals.title: Crypto security workshop
proposals.description: A security researcher teaches wallet and key hygiene.

proposals.title: Turtle nesting conservation
proposals.description: Support a local group protecting turtle nests on the beach.

proposals.title: Film screening nights
proposals.description: Projector, screen, and licenses for weekly films on the beach.

proposals.title: Hike to the waterfall
proposals.description: Transport and a guide for a hike to a jungle waterfall.

proposals.title: Startup pitch practice
proposals.description: Investors give feedback on pitches in weekly sessions.

proposals.title: Recovery lounge
proposals.description: Massage chairs and a quiet lounge for recovery.

opinions: Coworking upgrades, the chairs are terrible. Film nights would be fun.
Coworking upgrades and the waterfall hike.
Coworking upgrades first. Pitch practice too.
Upgrade the coworking space. Film nights.
Coworking upgrades and the hike.
Fix the coworking chairs. The security workshop would be useful.
Coworking upgrades. Pitch practice.
Turtle conservation is the only thing that gives back to this beach. Fund it fully, ideally more. Coworking upgrades are fine.
The recovery lounge would make the biggest difference to my health. Coworking upgrades are fine too.
disagreements: Mixed support for film nights (Persons 1, 4), the hike (Persons 2, 5), pitch practice (Persons 3, 7), and the security workshop (Person 6).
Strong single-person views: Person 8 wants turtle conservation fully funded or more; Person 9 wants the recovery lounge.

previous_slate.summary: Fund coworking upgrades, the hike, film nights, pitch practice, and turtles.

critiques: Good.
Good, the hike is in.
Fine.
Good.
Hike at $1,000 is fine.
Security workshop at its minimum is okay.
Good.
Turtles at $500 only covers half the nests. Please give them the full $1,000.
The recovery lounge got nothing. I'd take money from the hike and films.
disagreements: Most people are content; Person 8 wants turtles raised to $1,000; Person 9 wants the recovery lounge funded by cutting the hike and films.
